* DecodeResult represents the result from attempting to decode a sequence of EAP-TTLS * AVPs. It will contain either an EapTtlsAvp or an EapError. * *

In the case that multiple AVPs are received, all AVPs will be decoded and their AVP * codes/Vendor-ID will be logged. However, only the EAP-MESSAGE AVP will be stored in the * decode result. Furthermore, if zero, or multiple EAP-MESSAGE AVPs are received, this will * be treated as an error.

methods.name: public boolean isSuccessfulDecode()

* Checks whether this instance represents a successful decode operation.
